summary: Iteration 3 — Tested master-data setup: (a) Office Settings with default_work_start/default_work_end, (b) per-member mobile + work_start/work_end on POST and PATCH, (c) /api/members/import-template returning an .xlsx with the exact header row [full_name, mobile, email, password, rank, category, work_start, work_end] and a Members sheet, (d) /api/members/import multipart upload — full row + minimal row (auto email <mobile>@attendance.app + password = mobile) + bad row (missing full_name) → created_count=2, error_count=1, error references missing-name row; re-importing the same file → created_count=0 with 'email already exists' errors; (e) member-role 403 on PUT /office, GET /import-template, POST /import; (f) Regression on login, presence, admin/summary, attendance checkin/checkout (using current office coords from GET /office), scan-card with personal_qr, leaves create+approve, reports/hours — all green. 14/14 new pytest tests pass against the deployed preview. Frontend Expo web preview on 390x844: Login shows only 'Enter as Admin' quick button (no member quick button); the Admin TAB on /(tabs) renders 'Bulk Import Members' (admin-action-import-members) and 'Office Settings' (admin-action-office-settings) quick-action rows; tapping Office Settings opens the form with all seven testIDs (office-name-input, latitude-input, longitude-input, radius-input, work-start-input, work-end-input, save-office-button); saving valid values (TEST Office UI / 15.4909 / 73.8278 / 80 / 08:30 / 16:30) returns 200 and shows the green 'Office settings saved' toast; Bulk Import screen renders download-template-button and pick-file-button; Add Member form renders member-mobile-input, member-work-start-input, member-work-end-input. Camera/file-picker not exercised in web preview as per request. No deprecated Expo packages introduced. Pre-existing pointerEvents deprecation warning from a 3rd-party RN-web lib still appears.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' carried over from prior iterations. Non-blocking, originates in a 3rd-party RN-web lib.

action_items: No bugs to fix. Office Settings, custom timings, mobile field, Excel template + bulk import all work end-to-end.

Optional cleanup: /app/backend/tests/test_attendance_api.py (old iter-1 suite) is now stale because demo members were cleared this iteration — many of its 'member-role' tests fail at the setup step. Either delete it or rewrite it to create its own TEST_ members instead of relying on seeded demos.

Optional cleanup: /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py hardcodes office geofence as 19.0760,72.8777,100m. The office is currently Naval Academy (15.4909,73.8278,80m), so 2 of its tests fail with OUT_OF_GEOFENCE. Make it read office via GET /api/office first (the same way the new test_master_data.py does).
Camera/file-picker are native-only — verify on a real device build before release.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~895 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. High time to split routers (auth/office/members/attendance/leaves/reports).
import_members has no upper bound on rows; a 100k-row sheet would hold the event loop and the DB connection. Consider chunking + a row cap (e.g. 5000).
import_members regex `^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$` accepts '99:99' as a valid time. Validate hour 0-23 and minute 0-59.
MemberCreate.mobile is Optional with no format check, yet the import code derives a login from it. Adding a Pydantic validator (digits + 7-15 chars) would prevent garbage mobiles.

UserPublic exposes email, mobile, work_start, work_end to every authenticated user via GET /api/members. Earlier iterations also flagged that emails leak to non-admins; mobile + work hours now compound that. Consider returning a slimmer DTO for non-admins.
OfficeConfig defaults latitude/longitude to 0,0 which would put the geofence in the Atlantic if anyone PUTs without coords. Validation should require non-zero or at least sensible lat/lng ranges.
